# VIA NJ

> VIA NJ is an iPhone app for NJ Transit departures and track predictions at New York Penn Station.

## Website

- Homepage: https://www.vianj.app/
- Privacy policy: https://www.vianj.app/privacy-policy

## App

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/njt-departures-predict-tracks/id6742149117
- Platform: iOS

## Core features

- Live NJ Transit departures
- Predicted track numbers for trains departing New York Penn Station
- A fast, streamlined view designed for daily commuters

Track predictions are estimates. Riders should confirm final track assignments on official station boards and announcements before boarding.
